_doc: Generated by tools/tags.py compute from data/tags.json + the registry; do not edit (docs/tags.md).

groups.label: source
groups.description: Which book the stat block comes from.

groups.label: creature type
groups.description: The stat block's creature type, exactly one per monster. Prefixed so `dragon`, `giant` and `elemental` can mean the narrower family.

groups.label: family
groups.description: Lineage or kind: what the creature is (dragon, devil, canine, golem, npc ...). Every monster has at least one, unless listed in `no_family`.

groups.label: dragons
groups.description: True dragons by family, colour and age.

groups.label: role
groups.description: What an NPC-style stat block does in a fight or a story.

groups.label: movement
groups.description: How it moves, and whether it lives in the water.

groups.label: size
groups.description: Size category, exactly one per monster.

groups.label: challenge
groups.description: Challenge rating band, exactly one per monster.

groups.label: body plan
groups.description: The pipeline's body plan (docs/body-plans.md), exactly one per monster.

groups.label: pipeline
groups.description: What the generated asset supports. Not content: depends on the local out/ tree.

type-dragon.description: Dragon type: true dragons (`dragon`) and dragon-kin (`draconic`).

type-giant.description: Giant type: true giants (`giant`) and giant-kin.

dragon.description: True dragons, wyrmling to ancient (chromatic and metallic). Not dragon-kin: see `draconic`.

draconic.description: Dragon-kin: dragon-type creatures that are not true dragons (pseudodragon, wyvern, dragon turtle, half-dragon, kobold).

dinosaur.description: Dinosaurs and the prehistoric reptiles the SRD groups with them (plesiosaurus, pteranodon, archelon).

devil.description: Devils (lawful fiends of the Nine Hells).

elemental.description: Beings of elemental matter: the four elementals and elemental creatures (mephits, azer, xorn, salamander, magmin, gargoyle, invisible stalker). Genies are `genie`.

giant.description: True giants (hill, stone, frost, fire, cloud, storm).

hybrid.description: Chimeric creatures that join parts of animals or people (griffon, owlbear, centaur, harpy, minotaur ...).

sylvan.description: Woodland fey folk (dryad, satyr, sprite, centaur).

ghost.description: Incorporeal undead spirits (ghost, specter, wraith, shadow, will-o'-wisp).

plant.description: Plant creatures other than fungi (awakened plants, treants, shambling mounds).

npc.description: Humanoid NPC stat blocks (guards, mages, bandits, priests ...).

mammal.description: Mammals, natural or magical (implied by the mammal families below).

canine.description: Dogs and wolves, natural or magical.

equine.description: Horses and horse-like mounts (warhorse, pony, mule, pegasus, nightmare, unicorn).

serpent.description: Snake-bodied creatures: snakes, nagas, couatl, behir.

insect.description: Insects and other creepy-crawlies (beetles, wasps, centipedes, ankheg, remorhaz).

chromatic.description: Chromatic dragons (black, blue, green, red, white).

metallic.description: Metallic dragons (brass, bronze, copper, gold, silver).

warrior.description: Martial NPCs: soldiers, guards, gladiators, toughs, pirates, scouts.

leader.description: Captains and bosses that lead a band of lesser stat blocks.

aquatic.description: Lives in the water: swims, and walks 10 ft or less (or swims at least 3x its walk). Curated adds for marine creatures with a land speed.

amphibious.description: Swims and walks about equally well (has a swim speed, not aquatic).

avian.description: Body plan avian (two legs, wings or a beak-and-tail stance; also theropods).

aquatic-body.description: Body plan aquatic (finned swimmer; `aquatic` is the movement tag).

swarm.description: Body plan swarm: a swarm of tiny creatures (registry tag).

rig-ual.description: Rigged onto the shared UAL humanoid skeleton (manifest rig.tool ual).

rig-quad-canon.description: Quadruped rig with the canonical bone names (manifest rig.canon ok or partial; tools/quadcanon.py).

paired.description: Can take part in paired animations (UAL biped with shared clips; tools/paired.py).
